verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime original-Bengali novel book-publication span from Bou Thakuranir Hat to Char Adhyay; it is a selected publishing proxy, not a complete bibliography or claim of uninterrupted work.
workDates: 1883 — The Young Queen’s Market (Bou Thakuranir Hat)
verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use conventional Gregorian years for original Bengali book editions rather than composition, magazine serialization or later translations; English titles and transliterations are supplied for readability. Bengali year 1289 for Bou Thakuranir Hat spans 1882–1883, and the conventional 1883 date is used. Chokher Bali’s Bengali book appeared in 1903 and its English translation was serialized in 1914. Ghare-Baire appeared in Bengali in 1916 and in English in 1919. Char Adhyay appeared in Bengali in 1934; its English translation was serialized in 1936–1937 and published as a book in 1950. Poetry, plays, stories, songs, essays, art and posthumous publications are excluded.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
